name: Strongbox
description: An inventory organizer. Strongbox looks up everything you own and shows it by item or by chest: your bags, bank, house chests and other characters, with totals for each place. Find items scattered across many chests, mark a chest once and let the compass lead you back to it, and give your containers your own names. Open with /strongbox or the strongbox icon. Needs Lua API 55 or later.
author: Kronic
